sections.heading: Receipt record
body: Use one receipt per payment received. Record the facts on the day of receipt and file a copy with the ledger proof folder the same day.

sections.heading: Application note
body: State how the payment was applied across open items, oldest first, or per lease-specified order with clause citation.

sections.heading: Cutoff and math
body: Freeze a cutoff date and time before computing any claimed total. List every ledger line included with dates and proof references. Show the arithmetic from opening balance through charges, payments, and verified fees to the claimed total.

fields: Verified fees added with clause citations:
Re-cut needed if later payment arrives:

sections.heading: Identity and review
body: Confirm identities and address exactly as shown on the lease. Record delivery facts after service. Note review status. Verify notice rules and fee caps with state or counsel.

fields: Address and unit as on lease:

sections.heading: Properties and tenancies
body: List each property and each tenancy active during the year with active periods. Attach per-tenancy summary sheets.

sections.heading: Figures and questions
body: Provide organized totals with adjustments and arrears explained. List questions separately. Tax treatment is determined by the CPA.
